records.title: Small Models Struggle to Learn from Strong Reasoners
records.reason: The paper studies knowledge transfer from stronger reasoners during model training, not inference optimization.

records.title: ProgramBench: Can Language Models Rebuild Programs From Scratch?
records.reason: The paper measures program synthesis/reconstruction capability. The cache-related lineage association is not supported by its methods or results.

records.title: SlowFast-LLaVA: A Strong Training-Free Baseline for Video Large Language Models
records.reason: SlowFast-LLaVA uses a two-stream, token-budgeted approach for video LLMs and reports resource-sensitive results, but the contribution is narrow to video input and does not establish general LLM serving gains.

records.title: Semantic-Conditional Diffusion Networks for Image Captioning*
records.reason: Semantic-conditional diffusion networks for image captioning are an image-generation task/model paper, with no relevant LLM inference-system method.

records.title: A Survey of Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models: Towards Recursively Self-Improving and Collective Agents
records.reason: This is a broad survey of agentic reasoning rather than a concrete inference optimization method; any compute-efficiency implications are indirect.
